title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Tenure Share of the Deductible on Reconsidered Claims
content:
On a reconsideration of a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claim, the deductible charged is multiplied by the reconsideration's tenure share of the deductible, read from the covered Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement.

## Schedule

| Covered rental's move-in date, before the loss date | Rent payment reversal on the rental's ledger in the 12 whole months before the handling date | Tenure share |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 60 or more whole months | none | 0.5 |
| at least 24 and fewer than 60 whole months | none | 0.75 |
| fewer than 24 whole months | any | 1 |
| any | one or more | 1 |

Stated as a rule: the reconsideration's tenure share of the deductible is 0.5 when the covered rental's move-in date is 60 or more whole months before the loss date and the rental's ledger shows no rent payment reversal in the 12 whole months before the handling date, 0.75 when the move-in date is at least 24 and fewer than 60 whole months before the loss date and the ledger shows no such reversal, and 1 otherwise.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A tenant who moved in 61 whole months before the loss date with a clean ledger takes 0.5; a deductible of 180.00 becomes 90.00. The same tenant with a rent payment reversal 3 months before the handling date takes 1.
